Evidence/CLM-057
Evidence record

June and end-2023 borrower points are not one continuous series

What does this evidence establish?

The roughly 80,800 active-borrower point cited for June 2023 and the 78,686 end-2023 point come through different source chains. They are kept as separate observations until the provider sets and methods behind them are reconciled, and no June-to-year-end decline is calculated from them.

What does it measure?

Two counts of active microfinance borrowers in 2023, about 80,800 cited for June and 78,686 for the end of the year, reported through different source chains.

Who or what does it apply to?

Active-borrower observations whose set of providers covered by the evidence and source method are not yet proven identical between the June and year-end points.

When was it measured or observed?

June 2023 and end-2023 active-borrower observations from separate source chains.

How current is it?

Both observations refer to 2023, the later one to the end of the year; neither describes microfinance after 2023. They remain separate points unless the sources and provider sets are reconciled.

What this evidence does not establish

The two figures do not establish a decline between June and the end of 2023, monthly values between them, or a continuous series, while the provider sets behind them remain unreconciled.

Method and verification detailDetail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Both figures are taken as reported in two 2024 policy papers that cite different upstream sources. The observations are kept separate, and no change between them is calculated, because their provider sets and methods have not been compared and reconciled.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history.
